[[File:Jonathan Quesenberry Rebel Leaders 1997.gif|thumb|right|260px|Jonathan Quesenberry, Red Leader, 1997.]]
'''Jonathan Quesenberry''' (also spelled Jonathon) was Red Leader of Decipher's volunteer [[Squadron Members|Squadron]], working from Decipher Inc. The slot is marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" />

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support).

== Red Leader ==

As Red Leader he worked the Essen game fair in Germany in October 1996, where [[Winfried Sommerfeld]] helped him teach the game to German-speaking visitors.<ref name="decsq-sommerfeld">[http://decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/players/sommerfeldwinfried.html Star Wars CCG Squadrons: Red 41], decipher.com (page last modified 28 June 1999). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001023104822/http://decipher.com:80/volunteers/squadrons/players/sommerfeldwinfried.html Internet Archive]</ref> At the 1996 San Diego Comic-Con he and [[Mark Logoteta]] met [[Paul Hegyi]], who then began running tournaments in Sacramento.<ref name="decsq-hegyi">[http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/players/hegyipaul.html Star Wars CCG Squadrons: Red 18 profile], decipher.com. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19991221072943/http://www.decipher.com:80/volunteers/squadrons/players/hegyipaul.html Internet Archive]</ref> On Radio Free Decipher broadcast 10 he interviewed Sean Smallman on tournament software.<ref name="rfd10" />

== Signed cards ==

A photo of a [[Red Leader In Red 1]] card with a large gold-ink signature was posted to the r/starwarsccg subreddit on 1 September 2025, beside cards signed by [[Justin Pakes]] and [[Kendrick Summers]]. One reply by The_Abjectator pointed to the [[Squadron Members]] list, which names Quesenberry as Red Leader; a reply by jbhelfrich named [[Kyle Heuer]] as a later Red Leader but said the signature did not fit that name.<ref name="reddit-1n61y5w">_Sols_Golden_Curse_, [https://www.reddit.com/r/starwarsccg/comments/1n61y5w/does_anyone_recognize_these_signatures/ "Does anyone recognize these signatures?"], r/starwarsccg, Reddit (1 September 2025), with replies. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027185849/https://swccg.com/snapshots/reddit/r-starwarsccg-1n61y5w.html Internet Archive]</ref> The signature is attributed to Quesenberry (identification by comparison; see [[Talk:Jonathan Quesenberry|Talk]]).
